src = open('planner.py').read()
old = """    top = len(rset) - 1
    while top > 0 and not static_ok(rset[top]):
        top -= 1"""
new = """    lo_s = 0
    hi_s = len(rset) - 1
    while lo_s < hi_s:
        mid = (lo_s + hi_s + 1) // 2
        if static_ok(rset[mid]):
            lo_s = mid
        else:
            hi_s = mid - 1
    top = lo_s"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('planner.py','w').write(src)
